correctness.rationale: The output algebra a=A+mB follows by elimination of unobserved water. If B were constant, A=2u(u²-bu+1), a nonconstant polynomial of u, contradicting constant a for any nonconstant positive continuous trajectory. This proves the global two-time formula. Positive equilibria and the zero state give the stated exact parameter equivalence classes. A one-parameter perturbation reproduces every positive second jet, whereas the exact third-derivative difference is -epsilon u² Bdot, proving the sharp 3-jet criterion. Analyticity makes zeros of nontrivial Bdot isolated; the rational positive example has udot=2, Bdot=0, Bddot=20. Replayed SymPy identities verify these transformations and positive rational instances, with the infinite assertion proved algebraically.

originality.rationale: The directly closest published mathematical result proves full-state identifiability using observed water and biomass, not the present theorem with water completely unobserved; neither implication to a single-output theorem nor the sharp 2-jet/3-jet boundary follows from it. The inspected 2023 Bayesian inverse treatment observes a paired state, the 2017 study treats forward equations/equilibria, and the 2026 PDE source assumes a different observation operator. Targeted searches did not locate the same nonspatial scalar-output theorem. This is an evidence-bounded originality judgment, not a claim that absence of a search hit proves novelty.
residual_risks: The 2026 nonspatial Klausmeier uncertainty-quantification preprint was not verified in full text, and its appendices might contain relevant additional exact scalar-output statements.
The original 1999 model paper full text was not retrieved; its identified focus is vegetation pattern formation, but absence of inverse results in the uninspected sections was not assumed.
Generic differential-algebra observability results could subsume the model-specific theorem even without matching model names; semantic search alone cannot exclude such coverage.
The result assumes two unknown parameters and fully known normalizations; existing richer inverse problems may have overlapping special cases not indexed by these searches.

value.rationale: Water can be a latent ecological state while vegetation biomass is observable. The result gives a complete observation-only structural identifiability boundary (transient versus equilibrium/desert), an explicit reconstructive formula, and a sharp derivative-order requirement for local experiments. It meaningfully strengthens exact full-state observability without claiming numerical or empirical parameter-estimation reliability, and is more than a mere restatement of the known equilibria.
